type.description: Tunnel protocol used to connect to the remote peer.

address.description: Public address (IP or hostname) the remote peer connects from. The remote peer starts the tunnel.

auth.description: IPsec authentication material for the tunnel.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret in the tenant namespace holding the pre-shared key (key `psk`). Takes precedence over `psk` when set.

psk.description: IPsec pre-shared key. Autogenerated and stored in a Secret when omitted. Mutually exclusive with `existingSecret`.

remoteCIDRs.description: Remote networks reachable over the tunnel, at most 16. They must not overlap the cluster pod, service or join networks, node addresses or allocated LoadBalancer and external service addresses; an overlapping value is rejected.

staticRoutes.description: Optional extra static routes programmed on the router.

nextHop.description: Next-hop IP address for the destination.

bgp.description: Optional BGP peering over the tunnel. Disabled by default.

localASN.description: Local autonomous system number. Required when `enabled` is true; must be a valid ASN (1..4294967295).

remoteASN.description: Remote autonomous system number of the neighbor. Must be a valid ASN (1..4294967295).

resources.description: Explicit CPU and memory sizing for the router VM.

cpu.description: CPU cores allocated to the router VM, whole cores only and at least one. A fractional value such as "1500m" is rejected.

memory.description: Memory (RAM) allocated to the router VM.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for the router boot disk. Keep the `replicated` default where DRBD is available: only a DRBD-backed disk can live-migrate, and without live migration draining or losing the node drops the tunnel until the VM is rescheduled. Empty selects the cluster default StorageClass.

cloudInitSeed.description: Opaque value mixed into the VM firmware UUID. Change it to make the router apply its first-boot configuration again; leave it empty to keep the existing VM's UUID.
